entries.dialogueText: I entered the palace's residential wing and began making my way to my quarters.

entries.dialogueText: I was about to step closer when I felt a hand on my shoulder.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Your Majesty! There you are.""

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""It will be. Hopefully.""

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He shook his head briskly and withd..."
entries.dialogueText: He shook his head briskly and withdrew a seating diagram from his breast pocket.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""This will only be a moment.""
entries.dialogueText: "This will only be a moment."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He withdrew a seating diagram from..."
entries.dialogueText: He withdrew a seating diagram from his breast pocket.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""At table 12, we have delegations f..."
entries.dialogueText: "At table 12, we have delegations from Agard, Qinal, the Free Cities and Nahrburk."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Our guests from Qinal and the Free..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our guests from Qinal and the Free Cities refuse to sit next to each other or directly across from one another."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""The Qinali, meanwhile, would like..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Qinali, meanwhile, would like to sit directly to the left of our guest from Nahrburk, who in turn has asked to sit across from the Agardian."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Easy. Going clockwise, it's Agard,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Easy. Going clockwise, it's Agard, Qinal, Nahrburk, Free Cities."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Right. How about Free Cities, Nahr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Right. How about Free Cities, Nahrburk, Agard, Qinal?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""From the top of the table, it's Na..."
entries.dialogueText: "From the top of the table, it's Narhburk, Qinal, Agard, Free Cities."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have no idea. Ask someone else.""
entries.dialogueText: "I have no idea. Ask someone else."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Perfect. Thank you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Perfect. Thank you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel made a note."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel made a note.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Pabel, where is Vina?""

entries.title: Narrator: "I rushed back down the hallway to V..."
entries.dialogueText: I rushed back down the hallway to Vina's room. Bruno was standing there, barking in front of a wide-open door.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I went inside and saw that the wind..."
entries.dialogueText: I went inside and saw that the window was open as well. My mother was standing in front of it, her face pale as a sheet.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""WHERE IS SHE?!""
entries.dialogueText: "WHERE IS SHE?!"

entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I looked out the window at the pala..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Did you let her run away?""
entries.dialogueText: "Did you let her run away?"

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I... I don't know.""

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I... I have no idea what happened.""
entries.dialogueText: "I... I have no idea what happened."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I came here to give her some mothe..."
entries.dialogueText: "I came here to give her some motherly advice ahead of her wedding. I opened the door, and she was gone."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""She can't have gone far. The palac..."
entries.dialogueText: "She can't have gone far. The palace grounds are under heavy security."

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: Titus spoke into his radio. I struggled to make out the words on the other end.

entries.dialogueText: "I'm already on it, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion

entries.dialogueText: "I'm communicating with my fellow guards now, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If she didn't want to get married,..."
entries.dialogueText: "If she didn't want to get married, she could have just told me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If she wasn't happy, she could hav..."
entries.dialogueText: "If she wasn't happy, she could have just told me."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""She did tell you, Romus.""
entries.dialogueText: "She did tell you, Romus."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Interesting. Perhaps she was on th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Interesting. Perhaps she was on the phone."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""She did tell you, Romus.""
entries.dialogueText: "She did tell you, Romus."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I've received word that one of my..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've received word that one of my men left his shift early just now. He was complaining of indigestion."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Track him down. See that he gets w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Track him down. See that he gets what's coming to him."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You have to find him, Titus. I wan..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have to find him, Titus. I want my daughter back."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So she had an accomplice. I though..."
entries.dialogueText: "So she had an accomplice. I thought you Golden Guards were incorruptible."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I tried to reach him, but he's alr..."
entries.dialogueText: "I tried to reach him, but he's already turned his radio off."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion

entries.dialogueText: "I'm going to talk to the guards at the gates. See if I can find out more."
